Office & people

Connect a shared office so colleagues can sign in and work on the same board.

One-time setup required: create a Supabase project and run the supplied office-setup.sql file. Then enter the project URL and publishable key below. These identify the project; each person still needs their own sign-in.

Use the publishable key only. Never enter a secret or service-role key.

Sign in with the account created by your office administrator.

Your account has not joined an office. Ask your administrator to add your email, then click Refresh. If you are setting up a new office, create it below.

All deadline and completion dates use this office time zone.

Add an office member

First create their account in Supabase → Authentication → Users → Add user. Then add that same email here. Members can view, add, edit, and complete office tasks.
